**Executive Assistant to the CEO**

**Role Overview**

We’re looking for a detail-oriented, extremely organized, resourceful Executive Assistant to support the CEO and keep the day-to-day running smoothly. This role goes beyond managing a calendar: you’ll anticipate needs, bring structure to competing priorities, and help the CEO stay focused on the work that matters most.

The ideal candidate is a clear communicator who exercises good judgment, handles sensitive information with discretion, and takes ownership from start to finish. You’re comfortable working independently, asking thoughtful questions, and adapting when priorities change.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Manage the CEO’s time and priorities**

· Own a dynamic calendar, balancing meetings, focused work, travel, and shifting priorities.

· Evaluate scheduling requests, resolve conflicts, and make thoughtful recommendations about how to use the CEO’s time.

· Keep the CEO informed of upcoming commitments, deadlines, and decisions that need attention.

**Support communication and relationships**

· Help organize and prioritize email and other communications, flagging urgent items and drafting responses as appropriate.

· Serve as a responsive, professional point of contact for internal team members and external partners.

· Prepare correspondence, presentations, and other materials with accuracy and attention to detail.

**Create structure and improve how work gets done**

· Create and maintain organized administrative systems and processes.

· Build simple, repeatable processes that reduce back-and-forth and make daily work easier.

· Support research and special projects.

· Handle confidential business, human resources, and personal information with complete discretion.

**Keep on top of To-Do’s and keep deliverables & tasks on track**

· Coordinate meetings and ensure agendas, relevant documents, and preparation materials are ready in advance.

· Capture key decisions and action items when needed, and track owners and deadlines.

· Follow up thoughtfully to keep commitments moving and prevent important details from being missed.

**Coordinate travel and administrative needs**

· Arrange travel, accommodations, transportation, and create clear itineraries.

· Manage expense reports and related administrative tasks.

· Coordinate logistics for leadership meetings, team gatherings, and other events as needed.

**Minimum Qualifications**

· 10+ years experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive in an executive assistant role.

· Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities without losing track of details.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

· Sound judgment about what to handle independently, what to flag, and when to ask for clarification.

· A proactive approach: you anticipate needs, identify potential issues, and bring practical solutions.

· Reliable follow-through and a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

· Comfort working remotely and building effective relationships across internal teams and clients.

· Proficiency with MS products, calendar, email, presentations, and video conferencing tools, plus a willingness to learn new systems.

· Complete discretion, professionalism, and respect for confidential information and matters.

**Location and Working Hours**

This is a full-time, remote position with working hours aligned to Pacific Time. We prefer candidates based in the Los Angeles area and welcome candidates in other Pacific Time locations.

**How to Apply**

To apply, email your resume to Partnerships@EquityImpacts.com with the subject line “Executive Assistant - Indeed” Please include a brief cover letter identifying the top three qualifications, skills, or personal characteristics you believe are most important for success in this role. For each, explain why you consider it important and how you demonstrate it through your experience or approach to work.

Pay: $71,433.47 - $78,839.27 per year

Application Question(s):

* Experience managing confidential information and matters

Education:

* High school or equivalent (Preferred)

Experience:

* Executive administrative support: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: Remote

* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.
* Registers sales on assigned cash register, provides customers with courteous, fair, friendly, and efficient checkout service.
* In accordance with state and federal regulations, assists the pharmacist, under direct supervision, in the practice of pharmacy. Responsible for using pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).

**Operations**

* Provides customers with courteous, friendly, fast, and efficient service.
* Recommends items for sale to customer and recommends trade-up and/or companion items.
* Registers customer purchases on assigned cash register, collects cash and distributes change as requested; processes voids, returns, rain checks, refunds, and exchanges as needed. Takes customer to OTC aisle when possible to assist in locating products.
* Keeps counters and shelves clean and well merchandised, takes inventory, and maintains records. Checks in and prices merchandise as required or as directed by store manager or communicated by the shift leader.
* Performs duties as assigned by Pharmacy Manager, Staff Pharmacist and Store Manager including utilizing pharmacy systems to enter patient and drug information, ensuring information is entered correctly, filling prescriptions by retrieving, counting and pouring pharmaceutical drugs, verifying medicine is correct, and checking for possible interactions. Assists pharmacists in scheduling and maintaining work flow.
* Reports, immediately, prescription errors to pharmacist on duty and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Quality Improvement Program. Reviews and complies with the Walgreen Co. Pharmacy Code of Conduct.
* Strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription dispensing activities.
* Handles telephone calls that do not require personal attention of the pharmacist, including those to physicians.
* Processes (corrects and resubmits) manual claims for third party program prescription services in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager.
* Assists and supports Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities, such as, ordering, unpacking, checking and storing shipment of pharmaceuticals. Maintains knowledge of Company asset protection techniques, and files claims for warehouse overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods involving Rx drugs.
* Ensures compliance with state and local laws regarding regulated products (e.g., alcoholic beverages and tobacco products).
* Constructs and maintains displays, including promotional, seasonal, super structures, and sale merchandise. Completes resets and revisions as directed.
* Assists with separation of food items (e.g., raw foods from pre-cooked) and product placement as specified by policies/procedures (e.g., raw and frozen meats on bottom shelves). For consumable items, assists in stock rotation, using the first in, first out method and restock outs.
* Has working knowledge of store systems and store equipment.
* Provides customer service in the photo area, including digital passport photo service, poster print and creative machine, suggestive sell of promotional photo products.
* Assumes web pick-up responsibilities (monitors orders in Picture Care Plus, fills orders (pick items), delivers orders to customers as they arrive at store).
* Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring clean, neat, orderly store condition and appearance.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
* Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.

**Training & Personal Development**

* Earns and maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration.
* Attends training and completes PPLs requested by Manager or assigned by corporate and acquires continuing education credits. Maintains knowledge and skill in healthcare and pharmacy, including latest news and developments.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evenings and weekend hours.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.
* Prefer good math skills so they can fill prescriptions accurately, including counting, measuring and weighing medications.
* Prefer good computer skills.
* Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.
* Prefer PTCB certification.

The Plumbers Guild is a plumbing service company looking for a dependable person to answer customer calls, coordinate appointments and keep job records organized.

You will work directly with the owner and field technicians.

We provide training in Housecall Pro and company AI tools.

PAY AND SCHEDULE

$18–$22 per hour, depending on relevant experience.

Monday: 8 AM–5 PM Eastern, with a one-hour lunch covered by the company.

Tuesday–Friday: 1–5 PM Eastern.

Approximately 24 paid hours per week.

No regular evening or weekend shifts.

You must be available and working during scheduled hours.

This role starts part time.

There may be an opportunity for more hours or a full-time role as the business grows, based on business needs and performance.

Additional hours are not guaranteed.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Answer customer calls professionally and return missed calls promptly during your shift.

Gather customer information and the problem, check booking rules and technician availability, and schedule suitable appointments.

Ask whether the customer has other plumbing concerns to pass to the technician.

Keep records accurate, including how the customer heard about us, technician assignment, notes, photos, receipts and documented provider agreements.

Use company AI tools to check records, draft routine responses and identify missing information.

Verify results and follow through until missing items are resolved.

Coordinate customer updates and technician handoffs.

Bring pricing questions, technical questions, complaints and unusual agreements to the owner.

Keep records complete for Finance to reconcile settlement.

You will not independently set technician pay, approve refunds or release payments.

WHAT YOU NEED

Clear, professional phone manner and strong spoken and written English.

Dependable attendance, accurate record keeping and follow-through without repeated reminders.

Experience in customer service, scheduling, dispatch or office administration.

Plumbing or home service experience is helpful but not required.

Your own reliable laptop or desktop computer, headset with microphone, stable internet and quiet workspace.

A smartphone for company app access and account verification.

We do not provide a computer or phone.

Customer calls use the company phone system, not your personal number.

Comfort learning Housecall Pro and using AI tools.

No programming experience required.

You must check AI output rather than assume it is correct.

Respect for customer information and company account security.

The computer is the primary workstation.

The mobile app does not replace being at your workstation and available during your shift.

WHAT WE OFFER

Remote work with a consistent weekday schedule, paid training, direct support from the owner, company access to necessary software and AI tools, and an opportunity for more responsibility as the business grows.

This position currently does not include employer-sponsored health insurance or a 401(k).

HOW TO APPLY

Send your resume and a short note about relevant experience.

Confirm availability for the listed Eastern time schedule and that you have the required computer, headset, internet and workspace.

Selected candidates will have a phone interview.

Finalists may complete a short paid practical exercise using fictional customer scenarios.

6eefeeaaa3b5f7232c9c.description:
**Logistics Coordinator - Job Overview:**

The primary responsibility of a Logistics Coordinator is to manage the daily operational requirements of the freight brokerage while developing strong carrier relationships and supporting the transportation needs of assigned customers. This role requires a thorough understanding of the transportation market, carrier capacity, pricing, and the operational requirements necessary to execute shipments successfully. Success in this role will be achieved by proactively managing shipments from booking through delivery, developing a reliable network of carrier partners, negotiating competitive rates, and maintaining consistent communication with carriers and customers. The Logistics Coordinator will take ownership of daily operational challenges while working closely with the Account Management and Business Development teams to ensure customer expectations are met and transportation solutions are executed effectively. This role is focused on operational execution, carrier development, and the ongoing management of existing customer relationships. The Logistics Coordinator is expected to understand assigned customers' businesses, identify opportunities to improve service and efficiency, and help WHY Logistics deliver transportation solutions that balance cost, service, and profitability.

**Responsibilities**

**Transportation Operations**

* Proactively manage daily shipment activity and ensure carriers meet scheduled pickup and delivery appointments.
* Coordinate and oversee the operational execution of shipments from carrier booking through final delivery.
* Monitor shipment status and maintain communication with carriers to ensure timely and accurate updates.
* Identify, communicate, and resolve shipment delays, service failures, scheduling conflicts, and exceptions.
* Manage multiple shipments and priorities simultaneously with a strong sense of urgency and accountability.
* Ensure all shipment details, milestones, and documentation are accurately maintained in the company's Transportation Management System (TMS).
* Follow established operating procedures and customer-specific requirements to ensure consistent execution.
* Take ownership of operational issues and work proactively to minimize disruption to customers.

**Carrier Development**

* Identify, qualify, and develop relationships with reliable carrier partners to support customer transportation requirements.
* Negotiate carrier rates and secure capacity while maintaining service expectations and company profitability.
* Maintain regular communication with carrier partners to strengthen relationships and improve service reliability.
* Monitor carrier performance, address service issues, and identify opportunities to improve carrier utilization.
* Maintain an understanding of current transportation market conditions, capacity trends, and rate fluctuations.
* Develop strategies to secure reliable capacity during market disruptions, and challenging freight conditions.
* Ensure carrier qualification, insurance, safety, and compliance requirements before assigning shipments.

**Account Management**

* Develop a thorough understanding of assigned customers' businesses, requirements, and service expectations.
* Work with the Account Management team to ensure customer transportation needs are met effectively.
* Provide timely and accurate communication of shipment status, service exceptions, and corrective actions.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation processes, service levels, carrier selection, and cost efficiency.
* Understand WHY Logistics' approach, differentiation, and drive value through daily execution.
* Build trust with customers through accountability, responsiveness, and a commitment to resolving problems.
* Support customer onboarding, transportation bids, routing changes, and new service implementations as needed.
* Communicate recurring customer challenges and potential service improvements to internal team members.
* Help maintain and strengthen existing customer relationships through consistent operational performance.

**Qualifications:**

* Interested in building a career with a growth-oriented company.
* Driven, competitive, naturally passionate, and curious.
* Business-minded, with the ability to balance customer service, operational execution, and profitability.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to learn and absorb information quickly.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Team player who can also produce independent results and take ownership of responsibilities.
* Bachelor's degree or relevant equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years of logistics operations, carrier development, transportation brokerage, or related experience preferred.
* Understanding of truckload transportation, LTL, carrier procurement, and freight brokerage operations preferred.
* Ability to evaluate carrier pricing, market conditions, capacity, and service requirements.
* Strong analytical, mathematical, and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
* Transportation Management System (TMS) experience preferred.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, carriers, and internal team members.
* Travel Expectation – none required.

**Employee Expectations:**

* **Build Relationships for Impactful Growth** – Develop meaningful relationships with carriers, customers, and coworkers that strengthen WHY Logistics' ability to deliver reliable transportation solutions.
* **Tackle Challenges and Drive Solutions** – Take ownership of operational challenges, identify the root cause of problems, and proactively develop solutions that protect customer service and company profitability.
* **Gain Ground Through Incremental Development** – Continuously improve transportation knowledge, carrier negotiation skills, market awareness, customer understanding, and operational execution.
* **Embrace the Grind** – Understand that successful freight brokerage requires consistent communication, proactive follow-up, attention to detail, and a willingness to do what is necessary to serve customers and support the team.
* Maintain a high sense of urgency when managing shipments, securing capacity, communicating with carriers, and resolving operational exceptions.
* Build carrier relationships based on trust, communication, and mutually beneficial business opportunities.
* Take accountability for assigned shipments and customer requirements from booking through final delivery.
* Make informed decisions that balance customer expectations, carrier performance, transportation costs, and company profitability.
* Communicate proactively, professionally, and transparently with customers, carriers, and coworkers.
* Demonstrate initiative by identifying potential problems before they escalate and recommending solutions.
* Protect the reputation and profitability of WHY Logistics through responsible carrier selection, thoughtful rate negotiation, and consistent operational execution.

Pay: From $45,000.00 per year

f4514f6de2243179cf16.description:
### **A Little Bit About Us**

We offer exceptional vacation homes across the country's most celebrated ski towns and coastal retreats. Each property is carefully selected, locally managed, and held to an uncompromising standard of care. We live and work in the communities we serve, which means every stay comes with generous local knowledge, genuine hospitality, and the confidence that what you booked is exactly what you'll find.

### **Benefits**

We're proud to offer a competitive benefits package designed to support our employees both at work and beyond. Benefits and eligibility may vary by position and are subject to change. Full plan details and terms will be provided during onboarding.

Health, Dental & Vision Insurance  
401(k) with Company Match  
Paid Time Off (PTO)& Holidays (non-exempt employees)  
Paid Flexible Time Off & Holidays (exempt employees only)  
Paid Sick Leave

*Benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents, which govern in the event of any discrepancy. The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate benefit plans and programs at any time.*

**About This Job**

The Reputation Management Coordinator supports key administrative and operational processes that contribute to a positive guest experience and effective property management operations. This role is responsible for managing guest reviews and ratings, coordinating follow-up on guest concerns, and supporting the end-to-end unit termination and offboarding process.

Working cross-functionally with local market teams and other internal partners, this position helps ensure guest feedback is addressed appropriately, outstanding concerns are followed through to resolution, and departing units are accurately and efficiently transitioned out of First Chair Destinations' systems and operations.

**Compensation + Schedule**

* $20 - $23 / HR less payroll deductions and all required withholdings
* Monday - Friday schedule
* Fully remote
* Weekends and holidays may be required

**Essential Job Functions**

**Guest Reviews & Reputation Management**

* Manage guest reviews and ratings across applicable platforms, including reviewing incoming feedback, rating guests, and responding to guest reviews in a timely and professional manner.
* Ensure review responses reflect First Chair Destinations' service standards, brand voice, and commitment to the guest experience.
* Identify guest feedback that requires additional follow-up or escalation and coordinate with the appropriate local or internal teams.
* Track outstanding guest concerns and follow through with responsible teams to help ensure issues are appropriately addressed and resolved.
* Identify recurring themes or trends in guest feedback and elevate insights as appropriate to support service and operational improvements.

**Guest Concern Coordination**

* Partner with local market teams to address guest concerns identified through reviews, ratings, or other feedback channels.
* Facilitate communication and follow-up between teams when multiple departments are involved in resolving a guest issue.
* Maintain visibility into open concerns and help ensure agreed-upon actions are completed.
* Document relevant resolutions and follow-up activity as needed.

#### **Unit Terminations & Offboarding**

* Coordinate the full unit termination and offboarding workflow from notification through completion.
* Complete required system updates and administrative steps associated with removing units from the First Chair Destinations portfolio.
* Maintain accurate and complete documentation throughout the termination process.
* Coordinate with local teams and applicable internal departments to ensure required offboarding activities are completed on schedule.
* Track unit terminations through completion, following up on outstanding tasks and escalating delays or issues when appropriate.
* Help ensure internal systems, records, and documentation accurately reflect the final status of terminated units.

**General Functions**

* Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing program performance, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing process optimizations. Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to the function.
* Contribute to a collaborative work environment that promotes open communication, innovation, and employee engagement.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align departmental goals with broader organizational strategy.
* *Other duties as assigned because every day is different in hospitality!*

**Skills + Qualifications**

* Experience working in hotel, hospitality, vacation or similar industry is highly preferred.
* College education is strongly preferred, though we recognize that great talent comes from many different paths.
* Minimum 2 years of experience within a similar guest / customer facing support role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workflows, deadlines, and follow-up items simultaneously.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when completing system updates and maintaining documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple teams and follow issues through to resolution.
* Sound judgment and discretion when handling guest concerns and sensitive information.
* Tech-savvy with experience using various digital systems and applications and comfortable using mobile apps, tablets, and various software platforms.
* Comfortable talking to people—online or in person—and being able to share information in a way that's clear, thoughtful, and easy to understand.

**Workplace Environment + Physical Requirements**

* Fully remote work environment with reliable internet connection.
* Reliable transportation required.
* Typically a Monday - Friday workweek with expectations to be flexible to support the needs of the business.

*This job description does not identify every requirement of the position. First Chair may change position requirements, responsibilities, and work environment at any time with or without notice.*

*Some positions may require that you drive a personal vehicle and/or company vehicle for work purposes. Employees who are required to drive a personal vehicle must have reliable transportation, a valid driver's license, and be at least 18 years of age. Employees who are required to drive a company vehicle must have a valid driver's license, be at least 21 years of age, and have been a licensed driver for no less than 3 years.*

*An offer of employment for this role will be contingent upon the successful completion of* *a background check.*

**About Us**

Martin is a leading insurance advisory and consulting firm celebrating over 30 years in business. We support many national, regional, and local insurance carriers and managing general agents (MGA) throughout the US. Our insurance services focus on our client’s most important initiatives and opportunities: capacity, resources, operations, technology, due diligence, service, and practical advice. At Martin & Company, our goal is to build strong, lasting relationships with partners who share our values, vision, and commitment to mutual success.

**The Opportunity**

As the Director of our newly formed Professional Services Group (PSG), you will be the consulting lead for a portfolio of key client accounts. You will make sure every engagement is well scoped, meets Martin's quality standards, and delivers the outcomes we promised our clients.

In this role, you help define what great looks like. You set the requirements and standards for each engagement before our Operations team staffs and executes the work. That frees you to focus on what matters most: understanding client needs, scoping work precisely, safeguarding quality, and growing long-term client relationships.

This role is ideal for an experienced P&C insurance consultant who combines deep domain expertise with executive presence, enjoys leading senior client relationships, and wants to help shape a growing professional services practice. This is a remote position reporting to our Chief Professional Services Officer. Limited travel may be required for client meetings and company events.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Scoping and Business Development*

Discovery and scoping: Lead discovery and scoping for new opportunities, defining client requirements, deliverables, and delivery assumptions.

Deal review: Represent the Professional Services Group in reviews of complex or nonstandard engagements before commitments are made.

Scope management: Own changes to engagement scope, partnering with Sales on pricing and with Operations on capacity and timing.

*Client Leadership*

Trusted advisor: Serve as the primary consulting contact and a trusted advisor for your client accounts, including ongoing support for our largest clients.

Account growth: Lead value-focused renewal conversations and identify follow-on work and opportunities to expand client relationships.

Client outcomes: Make sure every client sees measurable value from their engagement with Martin.

*Quality and Standards*

Peer review: Conduct quality reviews on large and first-time projects before they are delivered to clients.

Continuous improvement: Maintain and improve the quality checklists used on routine work, and capture lessons learned across engagements.

*Partnership and Practice Building*

Delivery partnership: Provide clearly scoped work to our Operations team regarding client deliverables. Collaborate with Operations, provide input on staffing for key accounts, and partner on milestones, expectations, and project health.

Practice development: Contribute to consulting methodologies, playbooks, and reusable assets, and identify services that could be standardized or productized.

Mentorship: Mentor consultants in P&C domain knowledge and consultative skills.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* 10+ years of experience in P&C insurance, including at least 5 years leading client-facing consulting engagements
* Deep knowledge of the insurance product lifecycle, including product development, regulatory compliance, and state filings
* Proven success scoping complex engagements and managing scope throughout delivery
* Executive presence and the credibility to advise, and constructively push back with, senior client stakeholders
* A track record of setting clear standards and leading through others
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Attention to detail and quality
* Experience with simultaneously managing multiple projects and stakeholders

*Preferred*

* Experience at a consulting firm, carrier, or MGA serving multiple insurance lines
* Experience supporting technology-enabled services, platforms, or software implementations
* Experience building consulting methodologies, playbooks, or quality programs
* Experience and desire to be a People Manager is a plus, as this role will grow to have direct reports

**Why Join Us?**

**Growth-Oriented Culture:** Work with a leadership team committed to innovation and revenue expansion.

**Competitive Earning Potential:** Base salary plus bonus potential, profit sharing, and a comprehensive benefits package that rewards expertise and contributions.

**Legacy of Excellence:** Be part of a well-respected organization with over 30 years of leadership in the insurance industry.

**Dynamic Team Culture:** Work alongside talented colleagues who are passionate, driven, and committed to success.

**Salary and Benefits**

The base salary for this position is $120,000 to $150,000. Final salary offer will be based on several factors, including commensurate experience, qualifications, and skills. Our salaries are complemented by an extensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and work-life balance. These benefits include:

* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan options
* Generous, flexible paid time off (PTO) policy
* Fully remote work environment

cb37e28f9cd03c571415.title: Credit for Prior Learning and Career Progression Coordinator
cb37e28f9cd03c571415.description:
Position Information

**Position Title:**

Credit for Prior Learning and Career Progression Coordinator

  

**Posting Number:**

WPU0065217

  

**University Information:**

William Peace University (“Peace”) provides a culture that fosters an energized team environment, builds on our strengths, promotes creativity and innovation, and encourages respect and open communication. We value our faculty and staff. We know they are important and vital to the growth of our university and culture. Senior leadership is personally dedicated to the professional growth and development of each employee. We want to help you build your career, while ensuring you have great work-life balance and flexibility.
  
  
We teach our students the skills needed for ethical citizenship, not just in the classroom, but by example. We believe in giving back to our community, and our employees take pride in working at Peace.

  

**Department:**

Academic Affairs

  

**Purpose of Department:**

Housed within the Academic Affairs division, Peace Online advances William Peace University’s mission by expanding access to high-quality, flexible, and student-centered educational opportunities for online, adult, working, transfer, military-connected, and other nontraditional learners. The department supports students from inquiry through graduation by coordinating enrollment, academic success, career progression, retention, and completion efforts for online and adult-learning programs.

  

**Summary of Position:**

The Credit for Prior Learning and Career Progression Coordinator supports all William Peace University students, with a primary focus on Peace Online and military-connected learners. The position provides leadership for the development, implementation, and ongoing coordination of Peace’s Credit for Prior Learning (CPL) process, ensuring that students can translate prior learning into academic progress. In collaboration with Academic Affairs, the Registrar, Financial Aid, advising, Peace Online, Career Services, and faculty, the Coordinator ensures that approved credit is accurately applied and that students receive coaching for career advancement, job search strategies, and transition into new roles. The position offers specialized resources, orientation, and career guidance tailored to the unique needs of military-connected and veteran students while remaining an accessible resource for all learners across the university.

  

**Essential duties and responsibilities:**

**CPL** **policy and process management**

* Lead the development and implementation of institutional CPL policies, procedures, forms, and workflows in collaboration with Academic Affairs partners.
* Coordinate the student-facing CPL process, including outreach, intake, document collection, case tracking, and communication with students, advisors, and faculty reviewers.
* Serve as a liaison among academic departments, Academic Advising, the Registrar, Financial Aid, and student support offices to ensure accurate evaluation, transcription, and application of CPL credit.
* Coordinate with the School Certifying Official to ensure that prior training and credit for students using VA education benefits are evaluated and documented as required.
* Ensure CPL policies and processes adhere to institutional policies, academic standards, and accreditation requirements, including requirements for credit evaluation, documentation, and degree completion
  

  

**Prior learning evaluation support**

* Support and manage evaluation pathways for prior learning, including military transcripts (e.g., the Joint Services Transcript and American Council on Education credit recommendations), industry certifications, employer training, portfolio assessment, and other approved forms of CPL.
* Assist with the development of department-approved review rubrics, documentation practices, and equitable assessment processes aligned with program and course outcomes.
* Advise students on available CPL options and help them understand how prior learning can accelerate academic progress, reduce duplicative coursework, and support degree completion.
* Coordinate evaluation requests with faculty and academic departments, monitor review timelines, and communicate requirements, status updates, and decisions to students.
* Collaborate with faculty, the Registrar, and academic advisors to ensure approved CPL credit is accurately documented, recorded, and applied to students’ degree requirements.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of CPL best practices, accreditation requirements, and state/federal guidelines.
  

  

**Career progression support**

* Provide high-impact, individualized career progression coaching for Peace Online students and other adult learners, extending the reach of Career Services to learners not typically served by campus-based programming, including career exploration, advancement planning, resume and cover letter review, interview preparation, and job search strategy.
* Help students translate workplace and military experience into academic pathways and career goals, including support for career transition and advancement.
* Develop and maintain student-facing resources, workshops, and advising materials related to career progression, CPL opportunities, and pathways for online and military-connected learners.
* Partner with Career Services, Peace Online staff, and faculty to embed career progression and CPL conversations into advising, new student orientation, and program completion for online and military-connected learners.

Our mission is to assist homeowners swiftly and efficiently, ensuring their properties are restored to pre-damage condition with the same dedication and professionalism we upheld in service to our country. Service Ready!

We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Full-Time Administrative Coordinator to support our growing operations. This hybrid role combines administrative support, office management, and customer service, with a focus on insurance coordination and project tracking. Ideal for an organized professional with restoration or insurance experience, this position supports our mission-driven team in delivering exceptional service in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Answer and route incoming calls, manage voicemails, and respond to customer inquiries.

* Support HR tasks, such as maintaining employee files and onboarding paperwork.

**Office & Operations Management:**

* Coordinate technician schedules and dispatch for jobs, ensuring timely project execution.

**Customer Service Support:**

**Skills:**

* Ability to work independently, manage tasks with minimal supervision, and handle sensitive information with discretion.

Ensures the implementation of the sales strategy, guidelines and targets in a specified region, for the portfolio of a unit, in order to increase sales with all kinds of potential customers, and to achieve defined financial goals and sales targets.

**Regional Sales Director**

**Position Summary**

The Regional Sales Director is field-based sales leadership position responsible for driving commitment and accountability of a core laboratory sales team to achieve and exceed sales goals, grow revenue at assigned integrated delivery networks, hospital laboratories, regional reference labs and physician office labs. Focus will be on overall revenue growth for Siemens central lab product lines inclusive of chemistry, immunoassay, coagulation, hematology, plasma protein, allergy, automation, and information technology. Region covers primarily Colorado, Wyoming, Utah, Oklahoma, West Texas, and New Mexico.

**People Leadership**

* Accountable for the continuous development of assigned sales teams and for ensuring all direct sales are appropriately trained and competent in customer management, product and solution positioning, as well as all applicable sales processes and tools. Coach, promote, and manage adherence to commercial best practices.
* Responsible for hiring and developing a sales team of 6-8 direct reports. This includes setting appropriate mutual expectations that will be reviewed on a biannual basis, provide frequent feedback, and discuss individual development opportunities one time per year. Timely manage performance improvement cases if needed.
* Determine priorities to successfully pursue ‘must win’ deals including short-term (3 to 6 months) and long-term (2 to 3 year) strategic sales plans and ensure their implementation.
* Help coach team on account strategy and own the commercial outcome of new instrument opportunities (grow Reagent and Consumable Revenue, TCO, and instrument placements).

**Customer**

* Have direct customer relationships and understand the current market conditions in Region of responsibility and lead direct sales team to understand and address the customer’s needs and the effective delivery of the Siemens Healthineers value-proposition to the customer.

**Operational Excellence & Business Acumen**

* Own the execution and output of all key sales operational activities and metrics for sales funnel management, CRM tool rigor, sales processes, coverage on critical accounts, and overall financial health of each account including contract management and compliance.
* Be accountable and own capital and reagent forecasting in Region. Accountable for quality and accuracy of forecasting across all related product lines, as well as top and bottom-line financial outcomes for each deal.
* Own the commercial outcome of existing customers across Reagent and Consumable revenue growth, menu expansion and contract compliance for assigned accounts.

**Collaboration**

* Conduct regular reviews with Area Vice President and Field Product Manager- driving organization-wide commercial strategy within respective Region.
* Drive teamwork with the Siemens Healthineers Strategic Corporate Accounts organization, internal sales teams, distribution partners, technical and service organizations as well as develop strategy and implement tactics to achieve sales goals.
* Lead collaborative efforts with Siemens Healthineers teams within and from outside Region to ensure an excellent customer solution and experience, including but not limited to Health Systems Executives, Service, Technical Applications, Strategic Corporate Accounts, etc. as measured through regular customer feedback.
* Leverage Healthcare Consulting Services (HCS) and Informatics Sales Specialists for support during the sale cycle.
* Work jointly and collaboratively with several internal Siemens Healthineers teams to ensure a positive customer solution/experience. These teams consist of: Service, Technical Applications, Business Operations, Finance, Marketing, HR and other teams.
* Develop and manage a strong collaborative environment within team as well as other partners with accountability towards solution-based approach and balancing the needs of customers with the financial goals of the company.

**Overall Accountability**

* Directly accountable for leading assigned sales region to achieve and exceed sales goals across all Laboratory Solutions products, as well as for the financial performance of the Sales team in the Region.
* Manage and resolve business problems, especially in dynamic environments.
* Act with good judgment and decision making, aligned with Siemens Healthineers commercial strategy.

**Your Expertise:**

* Track record of success leading sales team (or sales team members) in Laboratory Diagnostics is required, and the candidate must reside and have experience in the Region with knowledge of the respective Integrated Delivery Networks.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.
* Inspirational leadership and motivating others, accountability and drive for results, organizational agility, ability to establish trust and rapport quickly and build effective team.
* Relevant business acumen to include standard competencies (financial, market positioning, healthcare industry, and customer relations).
* Experience in training and development, with a focus on coaching and mentoring.
* Proven record in a solution-selling environment and large account development, with 7 to 10+ years’ experience in a complex sales environment (Capital equipment, Medical, Devices, etc.). Experience in managing direct sales team preferred.
* Must possess a high level of strategic decision making with a focus on impact and speed, critical thinking skills, advanced sales skills, problem solving skills as well as objection handling skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing account-level deal strategy (Miller Heiman) & organizing team to execute on plan of action.
* Direct management of Sales Team experience within the IVD marketspace.
* Demonstrates success in communicating effectively with the Area VP to keep them informed about the progress and alignment of business priorities and results. This skill is also essential in effectively conveying the direction of the AVP to the Region sales force. Must be effective through email, Teams, and in person communication with customers, internal teams, and leadership
* Demonstrated knowledge of product lines, markets, and competitors.

**About Signify**

  
  

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

  
  

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

  
  

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

  
  

**More about the role**

  
  

**Job Summary**

Manages strategic relationships with key accounts to maximize opportunities in the lighting projects business to drive profitable growth and customer satisfaction. Leads the design and implementation of lighting solutions that meet customer requirements while promoting Signify’s connected and sustainable innovations. Coordinates cross-functional teams to ensure timely, high-quality project delivery.

Key Areas of Responsibility
  

* Manages assigned key accounts (Installers, general contractors, specifiers, project partners, end users) across the customer ecosystem, being accountable for all projects within the account, including direct responsibility for medium and large lighting projects.
* Delivers sales targets, revenue growth, and profitability objectives within the assigned territory.
* Builds and nurtures strong, multi-level relationships with key accounts and stakeholders (installers, contractors, specifiers, consultants) to influence product selection and secure specifications and to create pull for Signify’s innovations. Manages complex interactions across the customer ecosystem, including partners, alliances, and specifiers, ensuring alignment and collaboration across all phases of project development and delivery.
* Has an in-depth understanding of the market and defines an account strategy that drives profitable high growth opportunities for Signify as well as operationally managing the execution.
* Coordinates across Signify teams (e.g. Sales Specialists, Product Marketing, Order Desk, Quote Support, LiAS, Supply Chain, Customer Satisfaction etc.) with the objective of meeting account performance objectives and customer’s expectations.
* Collaborates with offer management and marketing teams to tailor offerings and drives continuous improvement initiatives by gathering client feedback and implementing solutions.
* Identifies and pursues project opportunities from early design stages through to execution and delivery.
* Monitors performance and manages accuracy of forecast and prepares detailed reports to inform decision-making. Tracks and keeps up to date project progress in CRM.
* Resolves project challenges proactively to ensure on-time, in-scope, and on-budget delivery.
* Leads commercial discussions and negotiates contracts to maximize profitability and strengthen customer partnerships.
* Promotes connected, digital, and sustainable lighting systems that address customer needs for efficiency, performance, and compliance
* Manages technical and commercial projects, including detailed calculations for pricing, product configurations, and margin analysis. Oversees the preparation and coordination of all project documentation—specifications, technical files, and customer proposals.
* Leads the end-to-end tender process for strategic projects, including identifying opportunities, coordinating internal resources, and preparing competitive submissions.
* Continuously enhances knowledge of Signify’s solutions, connected systems, and market developments. Participates actively in learning programs and sales capability initiatives.

Critical Experiences
  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related field, providing foundational knowledge in account management and strategic planning.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in key account management or sales within the lighting or related project ecosystem, demonstrating success in managing complex customer relationships and driving profitable growth. Experience working with specifiers, consultants, and contractors in a B2B environment (public and private sector).
* Relevant sales or project management certifications are essential to validate skills in managing projects and strategic accounts effectively.

  
  

**Everything we’ll do for you**

489748e10fda610cd7ab.title: Pharmacy Technician / Pharm Tech Apprenticeship
489748e10fda610cd7ab.description:
Our pharmacy technician positions have undergone an exciting transformation, moving from a transaction-based environment to a much more patient-centric one. As a Walgreens Pharmacy Technician or Pharmacy Technician Apprentice, you'll be front and center – interacting with our customers and developing strong patient relationships. Pharmacy is the core of our business, and our pharmacy technicians enjoy all the tools and support – including the latest technology – to grow their careers and reach their goals.
  
  
Walgreens is proud to invest & champion an “earn while you learn” Pharmacy Technician Training Program recognized by ASHP & Department of Labor. This apprenticeship program gives you an entry point to a career in health care by guiding you in taking steps towards becoming a Pharmacy Technician Certification Board (PTCB) Certified Pharmacy Technician and helping you maintain the high level of skill required in the pharmacy care industry. Arming you with a nationally recognized, portable credential that will help you advance your career.
  
  
Whether you are new to working in pharmacies or are an experienced Pharmacy Technician Apply Now! Walgreens will train you to use your skills and talents to serve and care for our patients and customers. The courses, learning activities, and resources provided to you in our pharmacy technician training program are designed to give you foundational and advanced knowledge, skills, and on-the-job experiences you need to prepare to become a certified pharmacy technician.
  

* In accordance with state and federal regulations, assists the pharmacist, under direct supervision, in the practice of pharmacy. Assists the pharmacist in the performance of other Pharmacy Department duties in accordance with Company policies and procedures.
* Responsible for using pharmacy systems to obtain patient and drug information and process prescriptions. If PTCB certified, assists with and coaches pharmacy technicians in the operation of pharmacy systems and cashiers in the operation of the pharmacy cash registers.
* Models and delivers a distinctive and delightful customer experience.

**Customer Experience**

* Engages customers and patients by greeting them and offering assistance with products and services. Resolves customer issues and answers questions to ensure a positive customer experience.
* Models and shares customer service best practices with all team members to deliver a distinctive and delightful customer experience, including interpersonal habits (e.g., greeting, eye contact, courtesy, etc.) and Walgreens service traits (e.g., offering help proactively, identifying needs, servicing until satisfied, etc.).
* Develops strong relationships with most valuable customers.

  
**Operations**

* Under the supervision by the pharmacist, assist in the practice of pharmacy, in accordance with state, federal, and company policy. Reviews and complies with the Walgreen Co. Pharmacy Code of Conduct.
* Performs duties as assigned by Pharmacy Manager, Staff Pharmacist and Store Manager including utilizing pharmacy systems to enter patient and drug information, ensuring information is entered correctly, filling prescriptions by retrieving, counting and pouring pharmaceutical drugs, verifying medicine is correct, and checking for possible interactions. Assists pharmacists in scheduling and maintaining work flow.
* Reports, immediately, prescription errors to pharmacist on duty and adheres to Company policies and procedures in relation to pharmacy errors and the Quality Improvement Program.
* Strictly adheres to the Walgreen Co. policy regarding Good Faith Dispensing during all applicable prescription dispensing activities.
* Responsible and accountable for registering all related sales on assigned cash register, collects and handles cash as required. Takes customer to OTC aisle when possible to assist in locating products.
* Handles telephone calls that do not require personal attention of the pharmacist, including those to physicians.
* Processes (corrects and resubmits) manual claims for third party program prescription services in a timely and efficient manner, and performs other clerical duties, as assigned by the Pharmacy Manager.
* Assists and supports Pharmacy Department on inventory management activities, such as, ordering, unpacking, checking and storing shipment of pharmaceuticals. Maintains knowledge of Company asset protection techniques, and files claims for warehouse overages (merchandise received, but not billed), shortages (merchandise billed, but not received), order errors or damaged goods involving Rx drugs.
* May assist pharmacist in administering clinical services including the collection and proper labeling of blood/urine samples from patients and other clinical services as required; assists pharmacy staff in coordination of clinical services, Walgreens healthcare clinics and external providers.
* Assists Pharmacy Manager and Staff Pharmacist in developing and maintaining good relationships with the local medical community, including physicians, nurses, and other health care providers, by medical provider detailing and outreach to health groups, retirement homes, nursing homes, and other forums for enhancing growth opportunities.
* Assists with exterior and interior maintenance by ensuring the Pharmacy Department is stocked with adequate supplies, clean, neat and orderly in condition and appearance.
* Complies with all company policies and procedures; maintains respectful relationships with coworkers.
* Completes special assignments and other tasks as assigned.

  
**Training & Personal Development**

* Earns and maintains PTCB certification through the designated PTCB training program and/or state required certification/registration. Otherwise, earns PTCB certification as condition of promotion to senior technician.
* Attends training requested by Manager and acquires continuing education credits. Maintains knowledge and skill in healthcare and pharmacy, including latest news and developments.
  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**
  

* Must be fluent in reading, writing, and speaking English. (Except in Puerto Rico)
* Requires willingness to work flexible schedule, including evening and weekend hours.
  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
  

* Prefer six months of experience in a retail environment.
* Prefer to have prior work experience with Walgreens.
* Prefer good math skills so they can fill prescriptions accurately, including counting, measuring and weighing medications.
* Prefer good computer skills.
* Prefer the knowledge of store inventory control.
* Prefer PTCB certification.

We will consider employment of qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
  
  
An Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans.
  
  
The actual compensation that you will be offered will depend on a variety of factors including geography, skills and abilities, education, experience and other relevant factors. This role will remain open until filled. To review benefits, please click here jobs.walgreens.com/benefits. If you are applying on a job board or unable to click on the link, please copy and paste this URL into your browser jobs.walgreens.com/benefits

------------

* ### **Prescription coverage**

9aa4be1ae7d528dbf7ad.title: Quality Manager Senior
9aa4be1ae7d528dbf7ad.description:
For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit modine.com.

**Position Description**
------------------------

At Modine, we are Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™. For more than 100 years, Modine has delivered innovative thermal management solutions that power critical industries worldwide. As demand for high-performance cooling solutions continues to accelerate, successful product development and launch execution are essential to ensuring customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and long-term product reliabiliy.

The Senior Quality Manager - New Product Introduction (NPI) is responsible for leading all quality planning and quality engineering activities associated with new product development and launch programs. This position serves as the primary Quality representative within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for ensuring quality requirements, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed throughout Modine's stage-gate product development process.

The role provides independent assessment of product, process, supplier, and manufacturing readiness while ensuring quality considerations are appropriately represented during development reviews and launch decision-making. Through proactive risk identification, structured quality planning, and cross-functional collaboration, the Senior Quality Manager helps ensure products are launched on time, with robust manufacturing processes, capable suppliers, and exceptional customer quality performance

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**NPI Quality Leadership & Stage-Gate Governance**

* Serve as the primary quality representative for assigned New Product Introduction programs.
* Lead all quality planning and quality engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle.
* Ensure completion of required quality activities and deliverables at each stage-gate milestone.
* Assess product, process, supplier, and customer quality risks and communicate readiness status during gate reviews.
* Provide independent quality recommendations regarding progression through development and launch phases.
* Drive accountability and closure of quality-related open items prior to launch approval.

**Design Quality & Risk Management**

* Participate as an embedded member of product development teams, representing the voice of quality throughout design and development activities.
* Facilitate Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA), Design Risk Reviews, Critical-to-Quality (CTQ) development, and Design for Quality (DFQ) activities.
* Ensure historical quality lessons learned, warranty data, and field performance feedback are incorporated into product designs.
* Partner with Engineering to identify and mitigate design risks early in development.
* Support development and execution of Design Verification Plans and Reports (DVP&R) and validation strategies.

**Manufacturing Readiness & Process Quality**

* Partner with Manufacturing Engineering and Plant Quality teams to ensure production processes are capable and launch-ready.
* Lead or facilitate Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Process Flow Diagrams, Control Plans, and process validation activities.
* Ensure quality requirements are incorporated into manufacturing processes, inspection plans, and production documentation.
* Support manufacturing readiness reviews and launch preparedness assessments.
* Coordinate quality activities associated with prototype, pilot, and production builds.

**Prototype, Pilot & Launch Support**

* Provide hands-on quality support during engineering builds, prototype builds, pilot builds, and production launch activities.
* Monitor build quality performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Lead investigation of build issues, nonconformances, and launch-related concerns.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented and validated prior to production release.
* Support transition of products into normal production and operational ownership.

**Quality Metrics, Reporting & Readiness Reviews**

* Develop and maintain NPI quality scorecards and launch readiness metrics.
* Track quality risks, open issues, corrective actions, validation status, supplier readiness, and manufacturing readiness.
* Present quality status, recommendations, and risk assessments during program and leadership reviews.
* Provide clear visibility of launch risks and mitigation plans.

**Required Education & Qualifications**
---------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering, Program Management, or related technical disciplines.
* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting new product development, product launches, or quality planning activities.
* Strong knowledge of:
* DFMEA
* PFMEA
* APQP
* PPAP
* Control Plans
* Process Validation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Experience leading complex cross-functional projects and influencing teams without direct authority.
* Strong communication, facilitation, project management, and risk management skills.
* Demonstrated success supporting product launches in a manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in data center cooling, HVAC, refrigeration, thermal management, or complex electromechanical products.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CMQ/OE), or similar certification.
* Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or Design for Six Sigma (DFSS) certification.
* Experience operating within a formal stage-gate product development process.
* Experience launching products across multiple manufacturing locations.
* Knowledge of fabrication, welding, brazing, refrigeration systems, heat exchanger manufacturing, sheet metal fabrication, and final assembly operations.
* Experience supporting global product development and launch teams.

Modine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Modine provides a competitive benefit package, which could include paid vacation, short term disability, 401(k), health, dental, vision, life insurance, flex spending benefits, tuition reimbursement, Health Savings Account and much more. Human Resources will provide more detail upon your hiring.

The salary range for this position is estimated in good faith to be [minimum amount – maximum amount]. The specific offer will depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and other job-related considerations but will be within the stated range. Where required by applicable law, a general description of benefits and other compensation offered for this role is also provided or made available.

16a85e518cbb99ac048b.description:
**Job Title:**

Individual Sales & Growth Specialist

**The Company:**

Medality is a radiology education platform that helps radiologists build subspecialty expertise through on-demand learning. Medality is part of TrueLearn, an educational software company, focused on empowering healthcare institutions and individual learners to maximize performance on high-stakes licensure exams. Through its suite of learning tools, TrueLearn and its family of brands have prepared hundreds of thousands of healthcare professionals in their pursuit of board certification, working closely with medical and health science institutions and residency programs across the United States. The company is growing rapidly and continues to innovate its platform and expand its portfolio of brands.

**The Role:**

TrueLearn is seeking a Growth and Sales Development Specialist with 3-5 years of experience in sales, business development, or growth marketing to drive individual (B2C) revenue across our education products, with a heavy focus on the Medality brand. This role turns marketing demand into closed sales by converting new leads, renewing and growing existing customers, and winning back lapsed ones.

This role is ideal for a consultative seller who enjoys building relationships with physicians and trainees and helping them find the right learning path for their career goals. The Growth and Sales Development Specialist will manage a high-volume pipeline of inbound and outbound opportunities, partnering closely with the Marketing and Sales teams to bring campaigns from launch through conversion.

The successful candidate will be comfortable juggling many conversations and priorities at once, writing personalized and persuasive outreach, staying organized and responsive, and spotting opportunities to improve conversion and retention.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

* **Lead Conversion:** Convert inbound and high-intent leads into customers, responding promptly and matching each prospect to the right product for their career stage, subspecialty interests and goals.
* **Consultative Selling:** Serve as a product expert for prospective customers, answering detailed questions about curriculum, CME, certification and access to help them make confident purchase decisions.
* **Outbound Outreach:** Plan and execute targeted outbound campaigns to audience segments defined by business need, such as subspecialty focus areas, cohort launches and seasonal promotions.
* **Follow-Up + Pipeline Management:** Manage a high-volume B2C pipeline with a disciplined follow-up process, accurately tracking outreach, outcomes and commissionable sales.
* **Renewals + Retention:** Own B2C renewal outreach for expiring customers and win back lapsed customers to maximize retained revenue.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and manage customer upgrades and account changes, including billing adjustments.
* **Sales Tools + Efficiency:** Use CRM, email and AI-assisted tools to scale personalized outreach while maintaining quality and accuracy.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Marketing on campaign timing, messaging and lead quality, and with Sales on account ownership and handoffs for group and institutional opportunities.
* **Customer Insights:** Share recurring objections, barriers to enrollment and customer feedback with Marketing to inform promotions and lifecycle strategy.

**The Skills Needed:**

* 3-5 years of experience in business development, customer success or growth marketing, preferably in EdTech, SaaS or healthcare
* Consultative selling approach, with the ability to understand a customer's goals and recommend the right solution rather than push a product
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to write warm, personalized and persuasive outreach at scale
* Comfort working with physicians and other healthcare professionals; familiarity with medical education or radiology is a plus
* Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage a high-volume pipeline and keep every conversation moving
* Belief that the best selling is human-led, backed by hands-on experience using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to streamline research, outreach and workflow
* Experience with CRM, email and e-commerce tools, and comfort learning new systems quickly
* Comfort with numbers, including pricing, discounts, prorated billing and tracking your own results against goals
* Excellent collaborator and proactive communicator who works well with Marketing and Sales
* Positive, action-oriented attitude and professional demeanor
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, goal-driven environment

**The Perks**

* Highly competitive benefits, including medical, dental and vision
* Additional benefits for employees to opt into
* Retirement: 401(k) with match
* Self-regulated PTO
* Monthly commission on B2C sales
* A diverse, challenging and fun work environment
* Fully remote workforce: work from the comfort of your home!
* The ability to influence how we work and directly impact revenue and the customer experience

**Compensation:**

* Base salary: $68,500
* Commission: 1.5% of sales sourced or influenced
* Annual bonus: eligible for up to 5% of base salary, based on company performance against goals
* On-target earnings (OTE): approximately $100,000

Pay: $68,500.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Disability insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Work from home

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: Remote

* Demonstrated ability to supervise staff, support performance management, and maintain service and quality standards

* Effectively able to develop self and others
