3198cdc32c43f076d9df.title: Forest Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) Expert
3198cdc32c43f076d9df.company: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
3198cdc32c43f076d9df.description:
**Job Posting**
---------------

: 13/Oct/2026

**Closure Date**
----------------

: 27/Oct/2026, 5:59:00 PM

Organizational Unit: FAINS - FAO Representation in Indonesia

**Job Type**
------------

: Non-staff opportunities

Type of Requisition: PSA (Personal Services Agreement)

Grade Level: N/A

**Primary Location**
--------------------

: Home-Based

Duration: 11 Months (66 Working Days)

Post Number: N/A

**IMPORTANT NOTICE: Please note that Closure Date and Time displayed above are based on date and time settings of your personal device**

*FAO seeks gender, geographical and linguistic diversity in order to best serve FAO Members in all regions.*

* **FAO is committed to achieving workforce diversity in terms of gender, nationality, background and culture**
* **Qualified female applicants, qualified nationals of non-and under-represented Members and person with disabilities are encouraged to apply**
* **Everyone who works for FAO is required to adhere to the highest standards of integrity and professional conduct, and to uphold FAO's values**
* **FAO, as a Specialized Agency of the United Nations, has a zero-tolerance policy for conduct that is incompatible with its status, objectives and mandate, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination**
* **All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference and background checks**
* **All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality**
  

**Organizational Setting**

Indonesia continues to strengthen its forest and land monitoring systems to support sustainable forest management, climate change mitigation, environmental reporting, restoration planning, and evidence-based decision-making. The Ministry of Forestry, through the Directorate of Forest Resources Inventory and Monitoring (IPSDH), is advancing the development and continuous improvement of national forest monitoring methodologies and systems, including the National Forest Monitoring System (SIMONTANA), the National Forest Inventory (NFI) 2.0, and related monitoring and reporting processes supporting national priorities such as FOLU Net Sink 2030, Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs), REDD+, forest governance, and access to climate finance.

FAO supports these efforts through complementary programmes, including Accelerating Innovative Monitoring for Forests (AIM4Forests) and the MERANTI Project. AIM4Forests supports Indonesia in introducing innovative monitoring methodologies and geospatial solutions, improving the availability and interoperability of forest datasets, strengthening MRV and climate-finance readiness, and developing monitoring approaches that can support ecosystem restoration, and traceability systems for transparent commodities value chains. MERANTI complements these efforts through the strengthening of NFI 2.0, integration of field and remote-sensing data, quality assurance and quality control, capacity development, and continued enhancement of SIMONTANA. In this context, the assignment will support coherence and complementarity across these initiatives, particularly where they contribute to strengthening the NFMS, SIMONTANA and related monitoring methodologies and applications.

A key area of technical support is the improvement of land-cover monitoring and estimation methodologies. This includes strengthening baseline and historical land-cover information, improving accuracy assessment and uncertainty analysis, and applying statistically robust approaches to estimate areas of forest and land-cover change. Such improvements are important for national forest monitoring, FOLU-related reporting, REDD+ MRV, and emerging climate-finance mechanisms.

At the subnational level, FAO is supporting the Government of Riau through the GREEN for Riau Initiative under the UN-REDD Programme. The initiative aims to strengthen the technical and institutional conditions for REDD+ implementation, including the development of a subnational Forest Reference Emission Level (FREL), forest emission monitoring, activity data and emission-factor development, data integration, and institutional capacity for MRV. Recent FAO-supported activities have included technical training on forest data collection and uncertainty assessment and work to strengthen Riau's subnational MRV system and climate-finance readiness.

FAO is also supporting Indonesia's broader forest and landscape restoration agenda through improved restoration planning and monitoring approaches. For example, FAO has introduced SE.PLAN, a spatially explicit restoration planning tool within the SEPAL/Open Foris ecosystem, and also FERM platform for monitoring, data collection and reporting on restoration initiatives. Such approaches provide opportunities to strengthen the link between restoration planning, implementation, and monitoring.

Against this background, FAO Indonesia seeks to engage a Forest Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) Specialist for an eleven-month period to provide technical and strategic advisory support services across the relevant FAO-supported forest monitoring initiatives and to strengthen coherence between national and subnational monitoring approaches.

The assignment will contribute to strengthening the NFMS across three complementary dimensions: policy and institutional/governance arrangements; technical methodologies, tools and data systems; and application of forest monitoring information for policy, planning and decision-making.

  

**Reporting Lines**

Under the overall guidance and supervision of the FAO Representative in Indonesia, the general supervision of the FAO UN-REDD MRV Expert, and the MERANTI National Project Coordinator,

  

**Technical Focus**

The Forest MRV Expert will provide technical support to strengthen Indonesia's National Forest Monitoring System (NFMS), with SIMONTANA as a key entry point, and to support coherence between national and subnational forest and land monitoring approaches.
  
Under the guidance of the designated FAO technical supervisors the incumbent will support data compilation and processing, desk-based technical reviews, preparation of draft technical documents, documentation of methodologies, and preparation of technical inputs for internal use and consultations with stakeholders. The Expert will participate in meetings, workshops, and other project activities, remotely or in person, at locations designated by FAO, as required.

The incumbent will provide task-based technical and operational support to FAO-supported forest monitoring initiatives and will work on assigned activities in accordance with established workplans, technical guidance, and instructions provided by the designated supervisors, and will prepare technical materials and documentation for internal review by FAO technical teams.

  

**Tasks and responsibilities**

**Support the development of the SIMONTANA Improvement Roadmap**

* Provide technical input to the development and refinement of the SIMONTANA Roadmap, including identification of priority technical improvements, data needs, methodological requirements, institutional arrangements and opportunities for improved interoperability.

• Support technical consultations with IPSDH and relevant stakeholders and contribute to the preparation and review of the SIMONTANA Roadmap and related technical recommendations.
  
• Support exploration of opportunities to extend the application of SIMONTANA/NFMS information to relevant cross-sectoral needs, including restoration, climate reporting, climate finance (i.e. REDD+ and TFFF), commodity transparency and other decision-making applications, as appropriate.

**Support the improvement of SIMONTANA’s technical and methodological foundation**

* Review and provide technical recommendations to improve SIMONTANA’s technical foundation, leveraging modern forest monitoring solutions and advanced remote sensing technologies to deliver more accurate, automated/semi automated, and consistent forest monitoring data.

• Provide technical input on enhanced minimum mapping unit to improve deforestation and forest degradation monitoring.
  
• Review available datasets and methodological approaches to update historical maps and align new time series data with the enhanced minimum mapping unit.

**Strengthen sample-based area estimation and capacity**

* Assist in compiling and processing data related to sample based area methodology, including the potential use of FAO tools and platforms to support more effective sample-based area methodology process, procedure and uncertainty assessment

• Support the development and/or refinement of technical guidance and practical approaches for sample-based area estimation.
  
• Support capacity-development activities for relevant government technical staff by preparing training materials, practical exercises, and knowledge-sharing documentation, as well as providing logistical and technical assistance during training sessions.

**Strengthen national FOLU climate-change reporting and MRV**

* Assist in reviewing and documenting national monitoring, reporting and verification (MRV) processes and climate-change reporting for the FOLU sector, including relevant linkages with FOLU Net Sink 2030, REDD+ and NDC reporting.

• Assist in compiling and documenting relevant methodologies, data flows, and reporting processes, including identifying data inconsistencies and preparing supporting materials for internal reviewSupport technical consultations and coordination with relevant government institutions and FAO technical teams.

**Provide technical support to GREEN for Riau Initiative and relevant subnational work**

* Provide technical support to GREEN for Riau Initiative on forest and land monitoring and MRV-related activities including integration with the NFMS.

• Provide technical expertise, review and input, as appropriate, for the establishment of Riau FREL, including policy and technical documentation.
  
• Support the technical review of national and subnational monitoring approaches, using GREEN for Riau Initiative as a reference case to identify relevant methodologies, tools, and lessons learned that may inform broader monitoring and MRV objectives.
  
• Support the drafting of ART-TREES documentations including TREES Registration Document and TREES Monitoring Report, as well as related V&V process.

**Promote the use of SIMONTANA/NFMS for thematic applications and decision-making process**

* Support the compilation and preparation of technical materials related to the use of SIMONTANA/NFMS for thematic applications and decision-making processes.

• Assist in processing and organizing forest monitoring data and preparing technical materials using remote sensing, spatial analysis, FAO-developed tools and platforms, and other relevant monitoring approaches to support commodity transparency.
  
• Support the development or refinement of forest monitoring methodologies, indicators and data requirements needed to serve these thematic applications.
  
• Contribute to relevant technical consultations, pilot activities, workshops and knowledge-sharing activities that demonstrate and promote the use of forest monitoring information for these applications.

**Other technical support**

* Participate in project meetings, workshops, field visits and technical consultations as requested by FAO.

  

**CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING**

**Minimum Requirements**
  
  
• Advanced university degree from an institution recognized by the International Association of Universities (IAU)/UNESCO in Forestry, Forest Resources Management, Remote Sensing, Environmental Science, Natural Resources Management, Climate Change, Geography, or another closely related field.
  
• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in forest monitoring, National Forest Monitoring Systems (NFMS), SIMONTANA, National Forest Inventory (NFI 2.0), remote sensing, forest carbon accounting, REDD+, and MRV.
  
• Working knowledge of English and Bahasa Indonesia
  
• National of Indonesia or resident of the country with valid work permit

  

**FAO Core Competencies**

* Results Focus

• Teamwork
  
• Communication
  
• Building Effective Relationships
  
• Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement  

**Selection Criteria**

* Demonstrated experience in supporting the development or implementation of national forest monitoring systems (SIMONTANA), forest inventories (NFI 2.0), or forest monitoring methodologies.

• Advance knowledge and demonstrated experience in forest and land monitoring, MRV and remote sensing/geospatial approaches
  
• Demonstrated experience in developing or reviewing FREL/FRL and REDD+ MRV related technical methodologies and documentation, preferably in Indonesia or other tropical forest context.
  
• Proven experience working with government institutions and international organizations on forest monitoring, climate change, or natural resource management programmes.
  
• Experience facilitating technical consultations, workshops, and multi-stakeholder engagement processes, with strong ability to provide technical advice and translate complex monitoring/MRV requirements into practical recommendations and documentation.
  
• Previous experience with FAO or other UN agencies is an asset.  

Please note that all candidates should adhere to FAO Values of Commitment to FAO, Respect for All and Integrity and Transparency.

*FAO’s commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations.*

  

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**

**HOW TO APPLY**

* To apply, visit the recruitment website at Jobs at FAO and complete your online profile. We strongly recommend that your profile is accurate, complete and includes your employment records, academic qualifications, and language skills
* Candidates are requested to attach a letter of motivation to the online profile

fc4bab18d074c9cdc67c.title: Customer Success Manager
fc4bab18d074c9cdc67c.description:
**About Us:**

Federal Compass is a leading SaaS provider offering a comprehensive suite of business process automation, pipeline management, and opportunity sourcing tools designed to empower Federal contractors. Our mission is to streamline the complex government contracting lifecycle, enabling our clients to identify, pursue, and win more opportunities. We're a high-growth company with a passionate team dedicated to delivering exceptional value and outcomes for our customers.

**Position Summary:**

The Customer Success Manager is a key member of our Customer Success team, responsible for ensuring that a portfolio of clients successfully adopts, uses, and derives maximum value from our platform. This role requires an **entrepreneurial spirit** and a **proactive approach** to problem-solving. You'll serve as the primary point of contact for clients, guiding them through the entire customer journey from onboarding to renewal. You'll be a trusted advisor, helping Federal contractors optimize their business development processes and achieve their growth goals by tailoring your approach to the diverse **personas** you engage with.

**Key Responsibilities:**

***Customer Relationship & Portfolio/Project Management***

* Serve as the primary point of contact for a designated portfolio of clients, building and nurturing strong relationships with both **end-users and key decision-makers**.
* Use data from **HubSpot** and other internal tools to **assess the health of your portfolio** and proactively identify at-risk accounts.
* Tailor your communication and engagement strategy to the specific role and needs of each person you interact with, from the day-to-day user to the executive sponsor.
* Act as a customer advocate, ensuring their feedback and needs are heard by internal teams like Product and Engineering.

***Persona-Driven Onboarding & Product Adoption***

* Lead the onboarding process by first identifying the key **personas** and their specific goals.
* Conduct onboarding sessions tailored to each persona's role—for example, focusing on pipeline tracking with a BD Manager and ticket management with an end-user.
* Focus on maximizing **product adoption** from the outset by actively guiding users to key features that align with their business goals.
* Ensure a swift **time-to-value** by helping new clients achieve their first key business outcome quickly.

***Problem-Solving & Support Tickets***

* Manage and resolve incoming **support tickets** from your clients, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
* Tailor your support and troubleshooting approach based on the user's role and technical proficiency.
* Take a self-motivated, proactive approach to anticipating customer needs and identifying potential issues before they arise.

***Revenue Growth & Retention***

* Manage the renewal process for your portfolio of clients by engaging with the appropriate **decision-makers** to demonstrate the product's value and ROI.
* Identify opportunities for **expansion and upsell**, positioning new features or products that align with the client's evolving needs, especially those of the executive personas.
* Collaborate with the sales and marketing teams to highlight the value of our platform and identify new growth opportunities.

***Time Management & Workflow***

* Independently manage your time to ensure the necessary focus is given to onboarding, customer check-ins, and the timely resolution of support tickets.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records and activities within **HubSpot**.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Gross Retention Rate:** Contribute to the team's gross retention rate by managing client relationships and mitigating churn risk.
* **Net Revenue Retention (NRR) / Net Dollar Retention (NDR):** Contribute to the team's NRR by identifying and driving upsell opportunities.
* **Time to Value:** Ensure new clients in your portfolio achieve their first key business outcome quickly.

216236334652d1fb1b0d.description:
**Every client conversation either builds trust or chips away at it. Your job is to make sure it always builds trust.**

Dog Lab Texas provides hunting, obedience and protection training, along with boarding and transport, for clients who expect a premium experience, and we guarantee our training results. Behind every great client experience is someone making sure the right message reaches the right person at the right time, and that nothing slips. As our Front Desk Coordinator, that’s you. You’ll be the communication hub for our clients and our team, and you’ll help us find and bring in the people who keep the business growing.

**What you get here**

* **Clear structure and clear expectations.** You’ll have approved templates, defined standards and real systems behind you, so you always know what “done right” looks like.
* **Leaders who are accessible and honest.** You’ll work directly with our leadership team, and you’ll always know where you stand.
* **Recognition for follow-through.** People who deliver get noticed here, and we say so out loud.
* **Room to grow.** You’ll get experience in client service and recruiting, with a path into a lead or coordinator role for people who show ownership.
* **A front-row seat to a growing premium business.** You’ll see how every part of the operation connects, and you’ll be the one connecting it.

**What you’ll do**

* **Be the communication hub.** Serve as the main coordination point for clients, team members and operational follow-up. Respond to every client message and inquiry in Go High Level promptly and professionally, using our approved snippets, templates and communication standards so clients get a consistent experience.
* **Make sure nothing stalls.** Handle every scheduling inquiry, appointment request and follow-up item within our expected response times. Watch communication threads so no conversation goes unanswered or unresolved.
* **Route work to the right people.** Send tasks, updates and follow-ups to the right team member based on who owns what. When ownership isn’t clear, ask before you assign so nothing gets delayed or miscommunicated. Keep communication accurate and timely across departments.
* **Coordinate the client schedule.** Manage lesson confirmations, field lesson invitations, boarding communication and appointment updates. Make sure clients get trainer and transporter ETA notifications on time.
* **Document everything.** Keep accurate records of every client interaction, update and scheduling change in our systems.
* **Keep leadership informed.** Prepare and submit a detailed end-of-day report covering operational activity, unresolved issues, urgent follow-ups, staffing concerns, boarding status, sales activity, client concerns, missed ETAs and scheduling updates.
* **Protect the client experience.** Watch for client concerns and escalate them appropriately when needed.
* **Support recruiting and onboarding.** Coordinate job postings, communicate with candidates, schedule interviews between candidates and leadership, track applicants and follow up. Help leadership keep candidate pipelines full for operational and administrative roles. Keep recruiting records, interview notes and hiring logs organized, and help prepare onboarding for new hires when needed.
* **Represent Dog Lab well.** Bring professionalism, responsiveness and organization to every client and candidate interaction.

**What success looks like**

* Every client and candidate gets a professional, accurate and prompt response.
* No conversation breaks down and no scheduling issue goes unresolved.
* Recruiting stays organized and responsive.
* Leadership gets accurate, on-time end-of-day updates.
* Our systems, records and tasks are always current.

**Who thrives here**  
You’re the person who notices when something is about to fall through the cracks, and you deal with it before it does. You enjoy keeping a busy inbox, calendar and task list under control. You write clearly, speak professionally, and stay calm when priorities shift mid-morning. You also see follow-through as a point of pride, not a chore.

**What you bring**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills (required)
* A high level of organization, follow-through and attention to detail (required)
* The ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while staying composed
* **Preferred:** prior administrative, front desk, customer service, recruiting or coordination experience
* **Preferred:** experience with Go High Level, another CRM or communication management system, or scheduling platforms

**Working conditions**

* The work is mostly computer-based: managing communications, scheduling and administrative tasks. You’ll be seated at a computer for long stretches.
* You’ll need to keep your attention to detail while handling interruptions and changing priorities.
* You may occasionally travel locally or help with operations, which can include lifting and carrying supplies up to 25 lbs.

**Pay and details:** $16/hr part-time - Most often 25-30 hours per week.

**How we hire:** We move quickly and usually make a decision within a week, and we’ll keep you informed at every step. (In this role, you’d be the one making sure every candidate gets that same experience.)

**If you’re the person who makes sure nothing slips, apply today. We’d like to meet you.**

Pay: $17.00 - $19.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Employee discount

**Director of Operations**

The Center for Wound Healing & Hyperbaric Medicine, LLC (CFWH) provides management and consulting services to healthcare providers in the area of wound care and hyperbaric medicine. By focusing on the needs of the patients as well as the partners we serve, The Center for Wound Healing & Hyperbaric Medicine, LLC is able to bring advanced wound healing strategies to many communities around the country.

**Our Core Values:**

Compassion, Excellence, Passionate, Integrity, Dedication, Loyalty, Accountability, Enterprising.

**Job Overview:**

As a member of the Senior Leadership Team, the Director of Operations will be instrumental in translating operational strategic goals into measurable execution plans and operational KPIs. This includes, but is not limited to, supporting the organization with optimizing workflows, creating/maintaining policies and procedures, communication and education support, compliance and safety, and building relationships. This position reports to the President/CEO.

**What You’ll be Doing:**

* Collaborate with the CEO and Senior Leadership Team in setting operational strategic goals on an annual basis, pivoting if/when business demands.
* Owns the end-to-end realization of operational strategic initiatives by aligning cross-functional teams and tracking milestones.
* Work with leaders across the organization to streamline workflows to improve effectiveness and efficiency; propose process improvements.
* Support senior leaders and managers on projects, policy implementation and procedural changes, as appropriate.
* Foster positive relationships with C-Suite and other identified hospital staff to support clinic's success at each location, as requested.
* Evaluate EMR systems to maximize capabilities and create/support workarounds for EMR roadblocks.
* Assist Program Directors and the VP of Business Development with identifying marketing needs and connecting with the marketing department for support and/or updating material for each individual clinic.
* Assist Program Directors and the VP of Business Development with the dissemination of marketing materials and supporting outreach initiatives.
* Assist Program Directors with identifying and onboarding clinic physicians, medical directors and key opinion leaders.
* Serve as an operational resource to Program Directors, managers and staff on a daily/on-going basis.Support and contribute to the company’s formal document control process for policies, procedures and work instructions.
* Support leadership to ensure clinical, regulatory, and accreditation compliance at wound centers and mobile units, as required.
* Provide tactical support for clinic openings, expansions, and relocations as directed.
* Consistently adheres to company, hospital, and accrediting body clinical, safety, and compliance standards.
* Ensures compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) by safeguarding patient information and maintaining the highest level of confidentiality standards.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Requirements for This Role:**

* 5+ years of experience in a management or project management role.
* 5+ years of healthcare experience, knowledge of outpatient process desired.
* Proficient in EMR, preferably Wound Expert and/or Intellicure.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools, particularly SharePoint preferred.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to inspire, motivate, and guide teams toward achieving organizational goals.
* Exceptional organizational skills required.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to treat others with compassion and patience.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced team-oriented environment.
* Must possess excellent interpersonal skills.
* All employees are required to comply with HIPAA policies and procedures.

**Desired Qualifications for This Role:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare administration, or a similar major preferred.
* Wound care and/or HBO industry highly recommended.
* Clinical certification preferred.

**Travel:**

This position requires occasional ground and/or air travel. This may result in travel up to 25% of the employee’s time.

**Physical Demands:**

The physical demands described are representative of those that must be met by a Wound Care Technician to successfully perform the essential competencies, duties, and requirements of this position. These include standing, walking, driving, lifting up to 50 pounds and sitting for extended periods of time and looking at a computer screen for extended periods of time. In addition, pushing, pulling, stooping, squatting and shifting heavy objects, as well as air travel, may be required. Employees should ask for assistance if needed.

**Vaccination Policy:**

Employment with The Center for Wound Healing & Hyperbaric Medicine, LLC or NexGen Hyperbaric, LLC is contingent upon attesting to health clearance requirements, which include, but may not be limited to: evidence of vaccination for/immunity to Hepatitis B, Influenza (Flu), MMR (Measles, Mumps and Rubella) Varicella (Chickenpox), Tdap (Tetanus and Diphtheria), Tuberculosis (TB) testing. Additional vaccinations, proof of immunity, or documentation may be required.

Employees are responsible to obtain all required documentation at the time of hire and as needed throughout their employment. Declination forms may be available for certain viruses/diseases. In some states, exemptions are available through an approval process for certain viruses/diseases.

**Benefits and Perks:**

The Center for Wound Healing & Hyperbaric Medicine, LLC offers eligible full-time employees and their dependents comprehensive health benefits and programs, which include medical, vision, dental, employer paid basic life insurance, buy-up life insurance, short term disability insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, critical illness, accident insurance and pet insurance to help you and your family take care of your whole selves. Other benefits include an easy to manage 401(k) with a retirement readiness tool, employee discount program, generous paid time off, and holiday pay.

***Equal Employment Opportunity:***

*The Center for Wound Healing & Hyperbaric Medicine, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

*This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.*

*As an organization, we are committed to offering reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to disability, please contact us at* *humanresources@nexgenhyperbaric.com**.*

83d9e52aad0c73fd11ff.title: Technical Support Engineer (Remote/Overnight)
83d9e52aad0c73fd11ff.description:
DataBank Holdings Ltd. is a leading provider of enterprise-class data center, cloud, and interconnection services, offering customers 100% uptime availability of data, applications, and infrastructure. DataBanks managed data center services are anchored in world-class facilities. Our customized technology solutions are designed to help customers effectively manage risk, improve their technology performance and allow them to focus on their core business objectives. DataBank is headquartered in the historic former Federal Reserve Bank Building, in downtown Dallas, TX.

DataBank is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our work culture at DataBank does not discriminate based on actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, disability or handicap, sex, marital status, veterans' status, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

The **Technical Support Engineer (Overnight)** is a member of the Support Operations team in the Managed Services department and reports to the Overnight Support Manager. This individual serves as the primary point of contact during overnight hours, providing system management, monitoring, patch management, and scheduled maintenance to meet and exceed the SLA requirements of DataBank while maintaining industry best practices in a multi data center environment. The Overnight Technical Support Engineer 1 addresses Windows, Linux, Cloud, Application, and Network issues and brings them to resolution, while executing planned maintenance windows and patching activities with minimal disruption to customer environments.

The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable working independently during overnight shifts. They thrive in a structured environment, follow established management procedures, and communicate clearly with both customers and day-shift teams during handoffs.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Overnight Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for all overnight customer incidents submitted via the DataBank portal or by phone
* Monitor and respond to alarms for DataBanks internal and customer systems, including proactive monitoring of all production systems for performance, failed hardware, alert conditions, and other issues affecting business operations
* Troubleshoot and resolve problems related to virtual platforms and virtual infrastructure including vCenter and vCloud; perform maintenance activities within the VMware platform
* Troubleshoot network issues related to routing, firewalls, and load balancers; escalate to Tier 2 teams as needed
* Fulfill overnight service requests for account creations and modifications including Portal accounts, Windows and Linux accounts, email, VPN, DUO, and FTP
* Adjust resources for IaaS and PaaS customers to include RAM, CPU, and disk space to meet customer requirements

**Patch Management**

* Execute approved patch management cycles for Windows and Linux server environments during overnight maintenance windows
* Apply OS-level security patches, hotfixes, and cumulative updates using tools such as WSUS, SCCM, or equivalent patch management platforms
* Validate patch deployment success, review system health post-patching, and document outcomes for each patching cycle
* Coordinate with the day-shift team and change management process to ensure all patching activities are pre-approved and scheduled appropriately
* Identify and report patch failures or systems requiring remediation; escalate unresolved issues with full documentation to the next shift
* Maintain patching logs and contribute to monthly compliance reports for customer environments

**Scheduled Maintenance**

* Execute scheduled maintenance tasks during approved overnight windows, including server reboots, firmware updates, storage provisioning, and configuration changes
* Perform and document decommissioning and provisioning activities for physical and virtual servers as scheduled
* Assist with backup verification and restore testing using tools such as Veeam, Commvault, or equivalent platforms; escalate failures immediately
* Perform DNS creation and modifications as part of scheduled change requests
* Coordinate and communicate maintenance activities with customers in advance, providing clear updates on status and completion
* Complete shift handoff documentation, summarizing all maintenance performed, incidents responded to, and any items requiring day-shift follow-up

**General Responsibilities**

* Management and operations of Microsoft Windows-based server systems and associated technologies including server clustering, DHCP, DNS, WINS, and DFS
* Configuration and management of Microsoft Active Directory, including implementations and interoperability with disparate directory structures and security methods
* Provide technical assistance to DataBanks customers for the support and management of Windows and Linux servers
* Perform ticket escalations to the appropriate IT teams within DataBank; coordinate with on-call engineers for critical overnight incidents
* Help create and maintain team standards, policies, and procedures; contribute to documentation updates and runbooks
* Identify and implement efficiencies to overnight processes and procedures
* May perform other duties and responsibilities that management deems necessary from time to time

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Education**

* Bachelors degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field; or equivalent work experience

**Experience**

* 3+ years of experience required in the Information Technology field
* 2+ years of experience working with Windows and/or Linux platforms; ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues at both an application and Server OS level
* 2+ years of working knowledge of virtual infrastructure technologies, specifically VMware vSphere and vCenter Administration
* Hands-on experience with patch management tools such as WSUS, SCCM, or equivalent; familiarity with patch scheduling, compliance reporting, and rollback procedures
* Experience executing scheduled maintenance tasks and change management procedures in an enterprise environment

**Technical Skills**

* Experience managing and configuring Active Directory including users, groups, group policies, replication services, and folder redirection
* Experience with network monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, ScienceLogic, SolarWinds, Nagios)
* Experience with Routers, Switches, Firewalls, and Load Balancers with knowledge of TCP/IP network administration and troubleshooting
* Experience supporting Microsoft products including SharePoint, Office 365, and SCCM
* Fundamental Backup and Patching knowledge; familiarity with Veeam or Commvault is a plus
* Understanding of authentication mechanisms including multi-factor authentication (MFA) and the OSI model
* Scripting experience with Python, PHP, or PowerShell is a plus particularly for automating patch or maintenance tasks
* Experience with Ansible is a plus

**Professional Skills**

* Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and organizational skills; strong written communication skills for shift handoff documentation
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision during overnight hours
* Reliable, punctual, and comfortable with a consistent overnight shift schedule
* Superior customer service skills; able to communicate clearly with customers during off-hours maintenance activities
* Analytical and detail-oriented; able to prioritize, execute, and meet deadlines
* A self-starter who excels in a structured, process-driven environment within a growing enterprise

**SCHEDULE**

This is a full-time overnight position. Shift hours and specific days will be discussed during the interview process. The role requires consistent availability during overnight hours and may include weekend coverage as part of the team's rotation.

**BENEFITS**

* Health, Vision and Dental Insurance Packages

34a6b83769ffec831b5a.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Shipping and Receiving Specialist to join our dynamic logistics team. In this vital role, you will oversee the efficient movement of goods in and out of our warehouse, ensuring accurate inventory management, timely order fulfillment, and seamless shipping logistics. Your expertise will help maintain smooth warehouse operations, support customer satisfaction, and uphold trade compliance standards. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast-paced environment where your skills in warehouse management systems and distribution processes will shine.

**Duties**

* Receive incoming shipments, verify quantities, inspect for damages, and accurately record data using RF scanners and inventory management software.
* Prepare outgoing shipments by picking, packing, labeling, and ensuring proper packaging according to shipping requirements.
* Operate warehouse equipment such as forklifts, reach trucks, pallet jacks, and order pickers to load and unload trucks efficiently.
* Maintain precise inventory levels through regular stock counts, data entry into ERP systems like AS400 or MRP software, and updating inventory management systems.
* Coordinate with logistics providers to arrange shipping schedules, track shipments, and ensure compliance with international trade regulations and trade compliance standards.
* Support warehouse distribution activities by organizing stock in designated areas for easy access and efficient order picking.
* Document all shipping & receiving activities meticulously, including inbound/outbound logs and incident reports when necessary.

**Skills**

* Strong proficiency with warehouse management systems (WMS), ERP systems (such as AS400), and inventory management software.
* Excellent knowledge of shipping logistics, order fulfillment processes, and warehouse operations.
* Skilled in using RF scanners, pallet jacks, reach trucks, and other warehouse equipment safely and effectively.
* Basic math skills for counting, measurements, and verifying shipment details accurately.
* Experience with packaging techniques suitable for various products to ensure safe delivery.
* Ability to perform data entry efficiently while maintaining high accuracy levels.
* Exceptional customer service skills to communicate effectively with carriers, vendors, and internal teams regarding shipment status or issues.

Join us as a Shipping and Receiving Specialist to play a crucial role in delivering excellence across our supply chain! Your dedication will ensure that our warehouse runs smoothly while supporting our commitment to quality service. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment with a focus on logistics precision and teamwork, we want to hear from you!

Pay: $17.00 - $17.50 per hour

Work Location: Hybrid remote in New Castle, DE 19720

b511b0471f2cec0f1c14.title: Staff Accountant-Full Time (Remote)
b511b0471f2cec0f1c14.description:
**Staff Accountant-Full Time (Remote)**

**Our Organization:**

CDP, a Boston-based public benefit corporation, uses the collaborative fundraising model to improve the operational efficiency and revenue generation capacity of the public media system. CDP currently provides more than 230 NPR and PBS public media organizations (PMO’s) with outsourced marketing, data analytics, fundraising, and technology services. These services help PMO’s raise more net income, grow their donor files faster, lower their fundraising costs, and free up development talent allowing stations to better focus on local engagement. Since its inception, CDP has delivered more than $1 billion in membership revenue for local PMO’s participating in its services and has become the most widely adopted Public Media service in the history of public broadcasting.

Just as CDP is committed to supporting public media organizations around the country, we are equally committed to supporting each of our team in their own professional development.

For more information visit www.cdpcommunity.org

**Role Summary:**

The Staff Accountant role at CDP offers a valuable opportunity to build accounting skills through hands-on experience and guidance from an experienced Finance team. With a primary focus on accounts payable and employee expense reporting, the selected candidate will gain exposure to the full accounting cycle, including billing, cash activity, reconciliations, month-end close, and audit support. Working with colleagues across departments, this person will learn how accounting connects to day-to-day business operations and develop broader responsibilities as their skills and experience grow. This role reports sits on the CDP Finance team and reports to the Senior Accountant.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

Accounts Payable:

* Own and manage the Accounts Payable inbox and ensure invoices are processed accurately and timely.
* Create and maintain vendor records, including new CDP employees when applicable, and collect required documentation such as W-9s and ACH/remittance information.
* Maintain accurate vendor payment methods and remittance contacts, including ACH, credit card, and check information.
* Maintain the current-year 1099 vendor/contractor listing and support annual 1099 preparation and processing.
* Enter vendor invoices into Sage Intacct and route invoices to the appropriate CDP reviewer and approver.
* Monitor Accounts Payable workflows and follow up with reviewers/approvers regarding outstanding invoices or approvals.
* Communicate with vendors and CDP employees regarding missing invoices, out-of-pocket invoices, payment documentation, and other billing-related questions.
* Access vendor portals and retrieve recurring or monthly invoices as needed.
* Maintain a working understanding of general ledger expense accounts and appropriate P&L classifications.
* Support monthly P&L reviews to identify missing expenses and potential accruals.
* Maintain a working understanding of prepaid expense accounts and related balance sheet activity.
* Support the review and reconciliation of prepaid expenses at month-end.
* Support the monthly out-of-pocket (OOP) expense process.

Expense Reports & Corporate Credit Cards:

* Support the monthly employee expense report process, including Expensify and corporate credit card activity, and verify that the vendor is populated on each expense when the system supports it.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding in Expensify and corporate credit card systems, including account setup, access changes, and coordination of card activation or cancellation as directed.
* Prepare and distribute monthly reminders to all staff regarding timely expense submission and approval.
* Follow up with employees and approvers regarding outstanding or incomplete expense reports.
* Perform the initial review of expense reports for accuracy, completeness, and appropriate supporting documentation. Route reports to the Manager for additional review, particularly during the first year; thereafter, follow review requirements and dollar thresholds established by Finance leadership.
* Provide basic Expensify support and troubleshooting to employees when appropriate.
* Assist with monthly corporate credit card reconciliations, including Visa, American Express, and Expensify activity.

Bank Statements and Reconciliation Support:

* Provide bank statements and supporting documentation for monthly bank reconciliations. The Manager retains responsibility for preparing and reviewing bank reconciliations to maintain segregation of duties.
* Research bank transactions and provide documentation to the Manager to help resolve reconciling items.
* Maintain organized and accurate bank statement folders by account, month, and year.
* Immediately escalate suspicious, unusual, or unidentified bank transactions to Finance leadership.

Other Duties:

* Support ad hoc Finance and Accounting projects as needed.
* Maintain organized, current, and accurate files and folders within the internal Finance drive.
* Assist with expense and financial analysis when appropriate.
* Support the year-end financial statement audit and related documentation requests.
* Identify opportunities to improve accounting procedures, workflows, policies, and internal controls, and assist with documenting approved changes.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with other CDP departments as needed.

Note: Responsibilities may evolve based on Finance team needs, business priorities, and the employee’s demonstrated experience and development.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Accounts Receivable & Billing:

* Assist with preparing and issuing client invoices through Sage Intacct accurately and timely, and serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day billing inquiries.
* Prepare, save, and maintain supporting invoice backup and PDF documentation when applicable.
* Maintain current station Accounts Receivable contacts and applicable CDP contacts copied on invoices.
* Maintain and update monthly and quarterly invoice-upload templates.
* Assist with updating the MSB billing tracker for MSB, PS, and CRM services as needed. The Manager retains responsibility for reconciling the tracker to client agreements to confirm billing completeness and accuracy.

– Update recurring invoicing information by station and product/service.

– Add new MSB stations and update assigned Client Services representatives when applicable.

– Maintain accurate license and email allotment information by station.

* Monitor billing-related email, respond to routine questions, and collaborate with Station Finance and other internal teams. Escalate discrepancies, agreement questions, and unresolved issues to the Manager.
* Assist with distributing Accounts Receivable aging statements to stations and supporting follow-up when appropriate.

Month-End Close:

* Support completion of the monthly Finance close checklist and PS close checklist.
* Prepare draft journal entries for prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned accounts.
* Assist with preparing monthly OOP journal entries and station-level allocations.
* Collaborate with MMT on station breakouts and supporting documentation when needed.
* Assist with monthly account reconciliations for corporate cards, prepaid expenses, accruals, and other assigned balance sheet accounts; provide supporting documentation for bank reconciliations performed by the Manager.

Systems and Experience:

* Experience with Sage Intacct, Bank of America CashPro, and Expensify is a plus.

**Commitment to Inclusion**

We strongly encourage individuals from historically marginalized and underrepresented groups to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value diverse perspectives, lived experiences, and commitment to public service. All CDP people have unique talents and experiences that create our company culture where we can all thrive and bring our whole selves to work each day.

Successful candidates will identify easily with a set of character attributes, as listed below:

* *DEI mindset*: You embrace and demonstrate a diversity and inclusion mindset and role model these behaviors for the organization.
* *A Communicator:* You possess strong communication skills and have great customer service skills; you like people and want to help.
* *A Critical Thinker*: You regularly look for ways to find efficiencies, innovate, and make improvements where you can.
* *Process Oriented:* You’re able to understand, work in, create, and improve processes.
* *A Collaborator:* You’re a team player willing to help where needed; a relationship builder whose can-do attitude inspires others; you actively share your job knowledge with team members.
* *Someone Who Seeks to Learn*: You are eager to listen, study, and learn new things quickly; you are resourceful and are open to regularly accepting and growing from feedback.
* *Enterprising*: You have proven success working in a fast-paced and changing environment; you have a strong work ethic and are excited to add value to the organization and its mission.

-

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, nationality, immigration status, citizenship, religion or religious creed (or belief, where acceptable), sex/gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and gender expression, pregnancy, marital status, age, citizenship, marital status, handicap or disability, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), Veteran or military status, political belief, or socio-economic status. 9614d4eedd09f1f4129b.title: Supply Chain Specialist
9614d4eedd09f1f4129b.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

**About the role**
------------------

Grüns is scaling fast, and our supply chain has to move faster than the demand. As our Supply Chain Specialist, you'll be the execution engine behind it: owning purchase orders from creation to receipt, keeping inventory and inbound data airtight, and catching risk before it ever reaches a customer. You'll work side by side with our Director of Supply Chain and directly with our suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role, and the work you do will protect product availability as we grow.

**This role is part of our remote HQ!** We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------

* Own day-to-day purchase order execution, moving every PO through production, shipment, receipt, and exception resolution without dropped follow-up
* Run the operating cadence with suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs, so every confirmation, delay, decision, and committed date has one clear owner: you
* Maintain the source of truth for available, inbound, and at-risk inventory, so the team always knows what we have, what's coming, and what's in trouble
* Spot shortages, production delays, material constraints, freight risk, and inventory imbalances early, and escalate with a recommended action, not just a flag
* Build Claude-powered workflows that turn raw PO, inventory, production, and freight data into exception lists, supplier communications, meeting recaps, and decision-ready summaries
* Standardize reporting, documentation, and recurring workflows (and write the SOPs) so the team can handle higher volume with fewer manual errors

**We're looking for someone who:**
----------------------------------

* Has 1-3 years in supply chain, operations, procurement, production planning, logistics, or inventory management, working close to the physical flow of product rather than only reporting on it
* Has worked in or around a fast-paced CPG, food/beverage, supplements, wellness, beauty, or other physical-product business (strongly preferred)
* Has coordinated directly with external suppliers, manufacturers, or logistics partners, whether in a full-time role or internship, and held them to deadlines across multiple workstreams at once
* Has hands-on experience with an ERP, inventory, or order management system (NetSuite-style) and can pull and organize clean source data without help
* Uses Claude or other AI tools daily for real operational work: writes strong prompts, builds reusable workflows, and validates outputs against source data before acting on them
* Can point to real examples of catching a problem early and driving it to resolution

**Approach to the role:**
-------------------------

* Highly organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of what matters most to the business
* Proactive: follows up before the deadline, not after something is already late
* Comfortable in ambiguity, and builds structure where processes are still taking shape
* Takes extreme ownership: closes loops and communicates risk early
* Collaborative and low-ego, while still holding internal teams and external partners accountable
* Treats AI as a force multiplier on the work, never a substitute for judgment

**Compensation & Benefits:**
----------------------------

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between **$80,000 – $85,000 plus bonus** depending on experience.

**A bit about us...**

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There's an infinite number of "nutrition" companies, all focused on what's best for them — not what's best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We've seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

  

**What we care about...**

**Be the Best:** We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

**Own It:** We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

**Drive Impact, Urgently:** We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

  

**Compensation & Perks:**

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage - for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

6c2c04d6be5d0de08e60.title: Senior Tech Support Specialist
6c2c04d6be5d0de08e60.description:
**Our Company**

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, and data they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by diversity and inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits, and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health equity on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Position Summary**

As a Senior Tech Support Specialist within Optum Technology's Enterprise Security division, you will join an L1.5 technical support call center team operating in a 24/7 fully telecommute / remote environment. Our team culture thrives on collaboration, continuous learning, mutual support, and a shared dedication to protecting enterprise security and data privacy. Serving as an intermediate escalation point for enterprise security, gateway infrastructure, identity/authentication, and privacy-related technical issues, this role requires exceptional critical thinking, multitasking abilities, and fast, accurate typing skills. Positioned between Tier 1 helpdesk agents and specialized Tier 2/3 engineering/compliance teams, you will troubleshoot complex technical escalations, manage real-time call and ticket queues, leverage enterprise-approved digital and AI tools to optimize support workflows, and triage privacy incidents while maintaining strict compliance with closely documented security and privacy standard operating procedures.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Serve as an L1.5 subject matter expert and escalation point in a 24/7 technical support call center environment for enterprise security, gateway infrastructure, authentication, and data privacy issues
* Apply strong critical thinking and analytical reasoning to evaluate complex technical escalations, identify potential privacy/security risks, and determine appropriate procedural resolution paths
* Multitask effectively across real-time phone queues, incoming ticket workflows, security monitoring tools, and internal communication channels simultaneously
* Document call notes, incident details, escalation logs, and support tickets rapidly and accurately via keyboard while actively engaged with end-users on phone calls
* Receive, triage, and troubleshoot L1-escalated calls and tickets related to security gateways, identity and access management (IAM), multi-factor authentication (MFA), single sign-on (SSO), and privacy concerns
* Strictly adhere to all closely documented processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and compliance workflows for security, access control, and data privacy purposes
* Identify, document, and triage privacy-related incidents, unauthorized access concerns, and data exposure flags in strict accordance with corporate privacy guidelines and regulatory requirements (e.g., HIPAA)
* Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools and digital technologies to streamline support workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and drive continuous operational improvement
* Evaluate emerging trends and technical support insights to inform continuous service improvements across call center operations and incident resolution processes
* Perform initial root cause investigation and technical analysis on security access, gateway connectivity, privacy flags, and authentication failures
* Maintain flexibility to work within a 24/7 support operational schedule, including rotational shifts, nights, weekends, or holidays as required to ensure continuous coverage

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma / GED required
* 3+ years of technical support, helpdesk, or call center support experience in an IT or technical service desk environment
* 3+ years of experience delivering customer service in a high-stress or high-sensitivity phone environment, with demonstrated ability to de-escalate frustrated callers while maintaining strict procedural, documentation, and compliance accuracy
* 3+ years meeting defined SLA/quality/productivity targets (volume, resolution time, and accuracy) in a high-volume enterprise CRM/ServiceNow environment
* 2+ years of experience troubleshooting enterprise security infrastructure, security gateways, identity/access management (IAM), or authentication platforms (e.g., MFA, SSO, SAML, Active Directory)
* 2+ years of experience working within closely documented operational procedures, compliance workflows, or data privacy guidelines (e.g., HIPAA, PII, PHI guidelines) in technical support operations
* 2+ years of experience in a 24/7, shift-based, or high-volume call center support environment, with demonstrated flexibility to work rotational shifts, nights, or weekends
* 1+ years of experience applying caller/requestor identity verification procedures and recognizing social engineering or unauthorized access attempts in a security or identity support environment
* 65+ WPM typing speed with strong accuracy

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field
* 2+ years of experience working successfully in a fully remote / telecommute technical support position
* 1+ years of experience utilizing AI-assisted productivity tools or automated workflow systems to enhance support ticket resolution
* Industry certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Network+, A+, or privacy-related certifications (e.g., CIPP)
* Experience working in a healthcare or HIPAA-regulated technical call center or service desk environment with defined SLA and queue performance targets
* Strong phone presence, active listening skills, and discretion when handling sensitive user data and privacy issues
* Demonstrated ability to multitask efficiently across multiple active communication channels, call queues, and technical applications simultaneously
* Proven critical thinking and problem-solving skills when resolving ambiguous or high-priority technical security and privacy issues
* Maintains a dedicated, private, HIPAA-compliant home workspace and secured network connection in accordance with company remote-work security standards
* All Telecommuters will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy.

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $24.00 to $43.00 per hour based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

**Application Deadline:** This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location, and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups, and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

*Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: UnitedHealth Group is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

*UnitedHealth Group is a drug-free workplace. Candidates are required to pass a drug test before beginning employment.*

Please check any communications to be sure they come directly from @irhythmtech.com email address. If you believe you have been the victim of an imposter or want to confirm that the person you are communicating with is legitimate, please contact taops@irhythmtech.com. Written offers of employment will be extended in a formal offer letter from an @irhythmtech.com email address **ONLY**.
