HRforGrowth® is engaged as the exclusive talent acquisition partner to conduct this search on behalf of a client organization that is hiring for this role. **HRforGrowth is not the employer for this position.** HRforGrowth identifies, evaluates, and presents top-tier candidates through its global talent acquisition practice; all employment decisions — including final selection, offer terms, compensation, and conditions of employment — are made solely by the hiring organization.  
**Position Title:** Yard Lead  
**Location:** High-Volume LTL Cross Dock Facility (100-130 Dock Doors)  
**Pay Rate:** $22.00 per hour  
**Schedule**

* **1st Shift:** 6:30 AM - 2:30 PM
* **2nd Shift:** 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM
* **3rd Shift:** 9:30 PM - 6:30 AM

**Position Summary**  
The Yard Lead is responsible for overseeing trailer management, yard organization, trailer tracking, trailer security, and hostler coordination within a high-volume LTL cross-dock operation. This role serves as the operational owner of trailer visibility and movement across the facility, ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly secured, accurately positioned, and available to support dock operations.  
The Yard Lead works closely with Operations Managers, Logistics Clerks, Shift Leads, Hostlers, Drivers, and customer representatives to maintain accurate trailer inventory, coordinate trailer movements, perform trailer inspections, and support efficient freight flow. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, urgency, communication skills, and the ability to manage a fast-paced operation supporting 100-130 dock doors.  
**Essential Responsibilities**  
**Yard Operations & Trailer Management**

* Maintain accountabilities for all trailers located on-site and off-site.
* Track trailer locations, movements, status changes, and door assignments throughout the shift.
* Ensure all trailer inventory is accurately recorded and updated in operational tracking systems.
* Coordinate trailer staging and movement to support inbound and outbound freight operations.
* Conduct routine yard audits to verify trailer locations and inventory accuracy.
* Investigate and resolve missing, misplaced, or incorrectly assigned trailers.
* Monitor trailer dwell times and support efficient trailer utilization.

**Trailer Security & Inspections**

* Perform routine trailer inspections and trailer checks throughout each shift.
* Verify trailer numbers, locations, conditions, and assignment status.
* Ensure loaded trailers are secured and locked when required.
* Verify trailer seals and report discrepancies immediately.
* Inspect trailers for visible damage and report maintenance concerns.
* Monitor yard conditions to ensure trailers remain organized, secure, and operationally ready.
* Maintain accurate records of trailer inspections and security checks.
* Lock trailers and perform trailer checks often.

  
**Hostler & Movement Coordination**

* Direct and prioritize hostler trailer moves based on operational needs.
* Communicate trailer movement requests between dock operations and hostler teams.
* Ensure trailers are staged at the appropriate doors to support production schedules.
* Coordinate emergency and priority trailer moves as business needs dictate.
* Support smooth traffic flow throughout the yard and docking areas.

**Operational Support**

* Partner with Operations Managers and Shift Leads to support daily operational goals.
* Provide updates regarding yard capacity, trailer inventory, and movement status.
* Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Support peak-volume operations and special projects as needed.
* Participate in shift turnover meetings and communicate critical operational information.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Promote a safe working environment throughout the yard.
* Ensure all trailer movements comply with company safety policies.
* Report damaged equipment, unsafe conditions, and operational risks.
* Conduct routine yard inspections and enforce safety standards.
* Support compliance with customer requirements and company procedures.

**Qualifications**  
**Required**

* High School Diploma or GED.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in transportation, logistics, cross-dock, yard operations, or warehouse operations.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
* Experience tracking assets, equipment, or trailers.
* Ability to work both indoors and outdoors in varied weather conditions.
* Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and operational tracking systems.

* Experience in LTL, transportation, trucking, or freight operations.
* Previous experience as a Yard Coordinator, Yard Jockey, Hostler Coordinator, Dispatcher, or Operations Lead.
* Experience with Yard Management Systems (YMS), Transportation Management Systems (TMS), or Warehouse Management Systems (WMS).
* Knowledge of trailer inspection procedures and yard safety standards.

This job is what Jerry is all about: helping our customers take care of their most important assets, their car and home, with the kind of warmth and speed they didn't expect from an insurance company.  
  
Car and home are people’s most important assets, yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every part of the journey - insurance, repairs, financing, maintenance - is fragmented, complicated, and expensive. Jerry.ai is building the first app to help people manage it all.

**The work is fast-paced, high-energy, team-oriented, and fully remote. A few things our team members love about working at Jerry:**

* Opportunities to shape the customer experience as the product and services are constantly evolving.
* Competitive wage and benefits (medical, dental, vision insurance, 401K match, paid vacation time).
* Stock equity (stock options) — we're a tech startup, and you own a piece of what you're building.
* Flexible scheduling: a 5-day, 8-hour or a 4-day, 10-hour work week.
* Fully remote, with work equipment provided.
* A career path in one of the largest industries in the world — insurance. We pay for your P&C insurance license if you don’t have one yet.
* And, importantly, the colleagues you work alongside. Ask our team what they value most and the answer is almost always the same: the people and the culture. Jerry is full of people who take their work seriously and take helping each other just as seriously.

* **Taking great care of our customers.** Our team members don't just answer the question asked — they catch the thing the customer didn't know to ask about. A coverage gap. A discount they qualify for. A renewal about to spike.
* **Answering inbound calls** from policyholders who need something changed.
* **Getting deep on the product.** With a large panel of insurance companies to work from, knowing which one fits which customer is the craft of this job. Our app evolves constantly too, and knowing it inside out makes you the person customers trust to navigate it.
* **Problem solving** to resolve customer inquiries effectively.
* **Processing service requests** — vehicles, drivers, lienholders, policy documents.
* **Making the product better.** Tell us what you're hearing. The feedback loop here is short enough that you'll see your suggestions ship.

* Strong problem solving skills
* Strong communication skills

**About Jerry.ai**

Jerry is building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets.

We are proud to consistently rank as one of Y Combinator's Top Companies, Forbes and Statista's Best Startup Employers, and to have received other accolades in fintech and insurtech innovation, workplace culture, and leadership.

We are a remote-first company, but if you prefer in-person or hybrid, we also have offices in Palo Alto, New York City, Chicago, and Toronto.

**Performance Home Medical** has been a leader in providing quality products and services since 1995.

At Performance Home Medical, our patients come first. Using the latest technology and best clinical support, we help our patients take control of their conditions and live longer and healthier.

We are seeking a motivated, high energy, individual to join our **Customer Service Team** in our Call Center. As a part of our Customer Service team, you must be responsible, reliable, detail orientated and can multitask in a fast-paced environment. You must also have good people skills to deal with patients, referral sources, and insurance companies on the phone and internet. Previous professional experience or educational background in healthcare customer service or is a plus but not required. A background in medical equipment preferred but we will train the right candidate.

We’ve got a fun, positive, performance-oriented team with a great culture and offer an extensive benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, 401k, EAP, 8 paid holidays and more. We also offer a comprehensive onboarding and training program to help ensure your success.

Job descriptions and needs would entail but not limited to:

* Answering incoming calls from Sleep, Providers and Scheduling queue in an efficient and courteous manner
* Maintain a current knowledge of products offered by PHM.
* Proactively offers and educates callers on resupply and private pay items sold by PHM.
* Generate new supply orders and process them according to procedure, ensuring timely and accurate resupply for patients.
* Collaborate with other PHM employees/departments to provide exceptional support to patients.
* Meet key performance metrics, including calls handled, average handled time and productivity.
* Other tasks that may be assigned by direct supervisor or manager, as needed.

* Technologically proficient with strong computer skills.
* Compassionate and empathetic with a commitment to providing the highest level of patient/customer care.
* Responsible and reliable.
* Quick learner.
* Team player that will contribute to a professional and fun working environment.
* Skilled in the art of de-escalation when problems arise.
* Troubleshooting patient issues with equipment, in person and over the phone.
* Operate phone systems in a professional manner.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Problem solver with a demonstrated track record of high performance.
* Positive attitude and a willingness to assist the team as needed.
* Highly organized and detail oriented.
* Procuring and completing any necessary documentation required.
* Prior knowledge/hands-on experience with PAP equipment - Preferred.
* Ability to type minimum of 30 words per min.
